Unfortunately, these findings do not hold true (= are not valid) for women and children.
Exercise can help in the development of social skills, and this is especially true for kids playing team sports.
The music is dull and uninspiring, and the same is true of the acting.
You never spoke a truer word (= used to emphasize that you agree with what somebody has just said).

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến sự thật thay vì những điều đã được bịa đặt hoặc suy đoán

senses.definition: real or exact, especially when this is different from how something seems

examples.x: the true face of war (= what it is really like rather than what people think it is like)
This project demonstrates the true value of teamwork.
The true cost of these experiments to the environment will not be known for years to come.
He reveals his true character to very few people.
I did not realize the true nature of their relationship.
She was unable to hide her true feelings for him.

senses.definition_vi: thật hoặc chính xác, đặc biệt là khi điều này khác với vẻ ngoài của sự vật

senses.definition: having the qualities or characteristics of the thing mentioned

examples.x: It was true love between them.
He's a true gentleman.
The painting is a masterpiece in the truest sense of the word.
He is credited with inventing the first true helicopter.

senses.definition_vi: có các phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm của sự vật được đề cập

senses.definition: used to admit that a particular fact or statement is correct, although you think that something else is more important

examples.x: It's true that he could do the job, but would he fit in with the rest of the team?
It's perfectly true that I didn't help much, but I was busy.
‘We could get it cheaper.’ ‘True, but would it be as good?’
True enough, but that doesn't tell the whole story.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thừa nhận rằng một sự thật hoặc tuyên bố cụ thể là đúng, mặc dù bạn nghĩ rằng điều gì đó khác quan trọng hơn

senses.definition: showing respect and support for a particular person or belief in a way that does not change, even in different situations

examples.x: a true friend
She has always been true to herself (= done what she thought was good, right, etc.).
He was true to his word (= did what he promised to do).
Many were executed for remaining true to their principles.
Knights swore to be true to their lord.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện sự tôn trọng và ủng hộ đối với một người hoặc niềm tin cụ thể theo cách không thay đổi, ngay cả trong các tình huống khác nhau

senses.definition: being an accurate version or copy of something

examples.x: The movie is not true to the book.
The painting is a true likeness of her.

senses.definition_vi: là một phiên bản hoặc bản sao chính xác của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: straight and accurate

examples.x: His aim was true (= he hit the target).

senses.definition_vi: thẳng và chính xác

senses.definition: to become reality

examples.x: Winning the medal was like a dream come true.
All her wishes came true.

senses.definition_vi: trở thành hiện thực

senses.definition: to give the impression of being sincere/true or not sincere/true

examples.x: It may seem a strange story but it rings true to me.
His expressions of support rang rather hollow.
His promise rang hollow.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ấn tượng về sự chân thành/thật hoặc không chân thành/thật

senses.definition: used to say that you cannot believe that something is as good as it seems

examples.x: ‘I'm afraid you were quoted the wrong price.’ ‘I thought it was too good to be true.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn không thể tin rằng một điều gì đó tốt như vẻ ngoài của nó

senses.definition: that you have used or relied on in the past successfully

examples.x: a tried and true method for solving the problem

senses.definition_vi: mà bạn đã sử dụng hoặc dựa vào trong quá khứ một cách thành công

senses.definition: your real character, rather than the one that you usually allow other people to see

examples.x: It was only after they got married that he showed himself in his true colours.

senses.definition_vi: tính cách thực sự của bạn, thay vì tính cách mà bạn thường cho người khác thấy

senses.definition: used to say that somebody is behaving in the way that you expect them to behave, especially when this is annoying

examples.x: True to form, she managed to upset everyone before leaving.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó đang hành xử theo cách bạn mong đợi họ hành xử, đặc biệt là khi điều này gây khó chịu

senses.definition: seeming real rather than invented

examples.x: I don’t think the characters are very true to life.

senses.definition_vi: có vẻ thật thay vì bịa đặt

senses.definition: used to emphasize that a particular statement, feeling, etc. is sincere or real

examples.x: She truly believes that none of this is her fault.
I'm truly sorry that things had to end like this.
I felt truly at home.
I do care. Truly, I do!
Does she truly love him?
He could never truly forgive her.
He truly wants to improve the town.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng một tuyên bố, cảm xúc, v.v. cụ thể là chân thành hoặc có thật

senses.definition: used to emphasize a particular quality

examples.x: The results are truly amazing.
It's a truly remarkable movie.
a truly great work of art
a truly memorable occasion
a truly magnificent performance

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một phẩm chất cụ thể

senses.definition: used to emphasize that a particular description is accurate or correct

examples.x: a truly democratic system of government
Well, really and truly, things were better than expected.
He started the first truly international ballet company.
They truly understand what we're going through.
a brand that is truly global

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng một mô tả cụ thể là chính xác hoặc đúng

senses.definition: completely

examples.x: By that time we were well and truly lost.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn

senses.definition: used at the end of a formal letter before you sign your name
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng ở cuối một lá thư trang trọng trước khi bạn ký tên

senses.definition: I/me

examples.x: Steve came first, Robin second, and yours truly came last.

senses.definition_vi: tôi/tôi

senses.definition: the belief that somebody/something is good, sincere, honest, etc. and will not try to harm or trick you

examples.x: Our partnership is based on trust.
This is a relationship built on mutual trust.
It has taken years to earn their trust.
We worked hard to gain the trust of local people.
Talking openly with your team helps to build trust.
Her trust in him was unfounded.
If you put your trust in me, I will not let you down.
I want to thank all those people who have placed their trust in me.
She will not betray your trust (= do something that you have asked her not to do).
He was appointed to a position of trust (= a job involving a lot of responsibility, because people trust him).
This is a serious breach of trust.
The company has to earn the trust and confidence of consumers again.
There is a lack of trust between the two countries.

senses.definition_vi: niềm tin rằng ai đó/điều gì đó là tốt, chân thành, trung thực, v.v. và sẽ không cố gắng làm hại hoặc lừa dối bạn

senses.definition: the belief that something is true or correct or that you can rely on it

examples.x: We place so much trust in computers that it gets a little scary.
Voters need to have trust in the voting system.
Public trust in science is harmed by inaccurate journalism.
If I were you, I would not place too much trust in their findings.

senses.definition_vi: niềm tin rằng một điều gì đó là đúng hoặc chính xác hoặc bạn có thể tin tưởng vào nó

senses.definition: an arrangement by which an organization or a group of people has legal control of money or property that has been given to somebody, usually until that person reaches a particular age; an amount of money or property that is controlled in this way

examples.x: He set up a trust for his children.
The money will be held in trust until she is 18.
Our fees depend on the value of the trust.

senses.definition_vi: một thỏa thuận theo đó một tổ chức hoặc một nhóm người có quyền kiểm soát pháp lý đối với tiền hoặc tài sản đã được giao cho ai đó, thường là cho đến khi người đó đạt đến một độ tuổi nhất định; một khoản tiền hoặc tài sản được kiểm soát theo cách này

senses.definition: an organization or a group of people that invests money that is given or lent to it and uses the profits to help a charity

examples.x: a charitable trust

senses.definition_vi: một tổ chức hoặc một nhóm người đầu tư tiền được giao hoặc cho vay và sử dụng lợi nhuận để giúp đỡ một tổ chức từ thiện

senses.definition: a group of companies that work together illegally to reduce competition, control prices, etc.

examples.x: anti-trust laws

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm các công ty làm việc cùng nhau bất hợp pháp để giảm cạnh tranh, kiểm soát giá cả, v.v.

senses.definition: being taken care of by somebody

examples.x: The family pet was left in the trust of a neighbour.

senses.definition_vi: được chăm sóc bởi ai đó

senses.definition: to believe what somebody says even though you do not have any proof or evidence to show that it is true
senses.definition_vi: tin vào những gì ai đó nói ngay cả khi bạn không có bằng chứng hoặc chứng cứ nào để chứng minh điều đó là đúng

senses.definition: to have confidence in somebody; to believe that somebody is good, sincere, honest, etc.

examples.x: She trusts Alan implicitly.
He has shown that he can't be trusted.
Never trust a man who will not look you in the eye.
a trusted adviser/friend
You can trust me not to tell anyone.
She nodded, not trusting herself to speak.
Which party do you trust to run the economy?

senses.definition_vi: có niềm tin vào ai đó; tin rằng ai đó là tốt, chân thành, trung thực, v.v.

senses.definition: to believe that something is true or correct or that you can rely on it

examples.x: He trusted her judgement.
Always trust your instincts.
a trusted source
Don't trust what the newspapers say!

senses.definition_vi: tin rằng một điều gì đó là đúng hoặc chính xác hoặc bạn có thể tin tưởng vào nó

senses.definition: to hope and expect that something is true

examples.x: I trust (that) you have no objections to our proposals?

senses.definition_vi: hy vọng và mong đợi rằng một điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to not trust somebody at all

examples.x: He says he just wants to help you but I wouldn’t trust him an inch if I were you.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn không tin tưởng ai đó

senses.definition: that you have used or relied on in the past successfully

examples.x: a tried and trusted method for solving the problem
Some teachers prefer the tried and trusted methods of language learning.

senses.definition_vi: mà bạn đã sử dụng hoặc dựa vào trong quá khứ một cách thành công

senses.definition: used when somebody does or says something that you think is typical of them

examples.x: Trust John to forget Sue's birthday!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi ai đó làm hoặc nói điều gì đó mà bạn cho là điển hình của họ

senses.definition: a person or an organization that has control of money or property that has been put into a trust for somebody

examples.x: The bank will act as trustees for the estate until the child is 18.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc một tổ chức có quyền kiểm soát tiền hoặc tài sản đã được đưa vào quỹ tín thác cho ai đó

senses.definition: a member of a group of people that controls the financial affairs and decides the policy of a charity or other organization

examples.x: the board of trustees
a trustee of the hospice
the trustees of the National Gallery
a trustee of the museum

senses.definition_vi: một thành viên của một nhóm người kiểm soát các vấn đề tài chính và quyết định chính sách của một tổ chức từ thiện hoặc tổ chức khác

senses.definition: the true facts about something, rather than the things that have been invented or guessed

examples.x: Do you think she's telling the truth?
We are determined to get at (= discover) the truth.
She had only spoken the truth.
So now you know the truth.
I knew the truth would come out in the end.
The truth is that there are no easy answers.
The truth of the matter is we can’t afford to keep all the staff on.
The sad truth is that, at 72, he is past his prime.
The simple truth is that new roads just encourage more traffic.
I don't think you are telling me the whole truth about what happened.
These documents reveal the truth about his past.
The awful truth about his disappearance finally dawned on her.
Only recently has the truth behind the killings emerged.
It’s the gospel truth! (= completely true)
I honestly don't know, and that's the truth.

senses.definition_vi: những sự kiện có thật về một điều gì đó, thay vì những điều đã được bịa đặt hoặc đoán mò.

senses.definition: the quality or state of being based on fact

examples.cf: there is no/some/much, etc. truth in something
examples.x: There is no truth in the rumours.
There is not a grain of truth in what she says.
His version of events does contain an element of truth.
You must be prepared to prove the truth of these allegations.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất hoặc trạng thái dựa trên sự thật.

senses.definition: a fact that is believed by most people to be true

examples.x: universal truths
She was forced to face up to a few unwelcome truths about her family.

senses.definition_vi: một sự thật mà hầu hết mọi người tin là đúng.

senses.definition: if you say that somebody has been economical with the truth, you mean that they left out some important facts, but you do not want to say that they were lying
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói rằng ai đó đã 'tiết kiệm sự thật', bạn có nghĩa là họ đã bỏ qua một số sự thật quan trọng, nhưng bạn không muốn nói rằng họ đã nói dối.

senses.definition: to say something that is not completely true

examples.x: I wasn’t exactly lying when I said I hadn’t seen her—I was just bending the truth a little.

senses.definition_vi: nói một điều gì đó không hoàn toàn đúng.

senses.definition: used to tell somebody the true facts about a situation, especially when these are not known by other people

examples.x: If the truth be known, I was afraid to tell anyone.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó sự thật về một tình huống, đặc biệt là khi những người khác không biết.

senses.definition: used to emphasize the true facts about a situation

examples.x: She laughed and chatted but was, in truth, not having much fun.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh sự thật về một tình huống.

senses.definition: a time when somebody/something is tested, or when important decisions are made

examples.x: The moment of truth is when the trainee pilots take over the controls of the plane.

senses.definition_vi: một thời điểm khi ai đó/điều gì đó được thử thách, hoặc khi các quyết định quan trọng được đưa ra.

senses.definition: used to say that a fact or comment is completely false

examples.x: She thinks I don’t like her but nothing could be further from the truth.
I know you think she's mean, but nothing could be further from the truth.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng một sự thật hoặc nhận xét là hoàn toàn sai.

senses.definition: used when admitting something

examples.x: To tell you the truth, I'll be glad to get home.
I got a bit big-headed, to tell the truth.
To tell you the truth, I'm rather dreading his return.

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi thừa nhận một điều gì đó.

senses.definition: used to say that things that actually happen are often more surprising than stories that are invented
senses.short_meaning_vi: sự thật còn hơn cả hư cấu
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng những gì thực sự xảy ra thường đáng ngạc nhiên hơn những câu chuyện được bịa đặt.

senses.definition: used to say that people will find out the true facts about a situation even if you try to keep them secret
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng mọi người sẽ khám phá ra sự thật về một tình huống ngay cả khi bạn cố gắng giữ bí mật.

senses.definition: an act of trying to do something

examples.x: I doubt they'll be able to help but it's worth a try (= worth asking them).
Why don't you have a try at convincing him?
The US negotiators decided to make another try at reaching a settlement.
This is my first try at fiction.
‘What's that behind you?’ ‘Nice try (= at making me turn round), but you'll have to do better than that!’

senses.definition_vi: một hành động cố gắng làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: an act of trying something new or different to see if it is good, suitable, etc.

examples.x: I don't think I'll be any good at tennis, but I'll give it a try.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động thử một cái gì đó mới hoặc khác để xem nó có tốt, phù hợp, v.v. không.

senses.definition: an act of scoring points by touching the ground behind your opponents’ goal line with the ball

examples.x: to score a try
an excellent try by winger Neil Lang

senses.definition_vi: một hành động ghi điểm bằng cách chạm bóng vào phía sau vạch khung thành của đối phương.

senses.definition: to make an attempt or effort to do or get something

examples.x: I don't know if I can come but I'll try.
What are you trying to do?
I tried hard not to laugh.
You haven’t even tried to find it.
Don’t try to do it too quickly.
I kept trying to remember where I had seen him before.
I was just trying to help!
She was desperately trying to stay afloat.
She tried her best to solve the problem.
Just try your hardest.
I tried calling him but there was no answer.
Just try getting a plumber at the weekend!
He tried and tried but he could not climb out.
Please try again later.

senses.definition_vi: nỗ lực hoặc cố gắng làm hoặc đạt được điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to use, do or test something in order to see if it is good, suitable, etc.

examples.x: Have you tried this new coffee? It's very good.
‘Would you like to try some raw fish?’ ‘Why not? I'll try anything once!’
I'd like to try something new.
I'm having a caffeine-free week. You should try it.
Have you ever tried windsurfing?
Try these shoes for size—they should fit you.
She tried the door, but it was locked.
The treatment has not yet been tried on patients.
John isn't here. Try phoning his mobile.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng, làm hoặc kiểm tra một cái gì đó để xem nó có tốt, phù hợp, v.v. không.

senses.definition: to examine evidence in court and decide whether somebody is innocent or guilty

examples.x: He was tried for murder.
The case was tried before a jury.

senses.definition_vi: kiểm tra bằng chứng tại tòa và quyết định xem ai đó có vô tội hay có tội.

senses.definition: to try as hard as you can (to do something)

examples.x: She did her damnedest to get it done on time.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng hết sức (để làm điều gì đó).

senses.definition: to do as much as you can to try to achieve something
senses.definition_vi: làm hết sức mình để cố gắng đạt được điều gì đó.

senses.definition: used to say that although somebody has not succeeded in something, they have tried very hard

examples.x: They haven't won a game yet, but it isn't for want of trying.
They lost the game, but not for lack of trying.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng mặc dù ai đó đã không thành công trong việc gì đó, họ đã cố gắng rất nhiều.

senses.definition: used to say that you should accept an unpleasant situation or event because you cannot change it
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn nên chấp nhận một tình huống hoặc sự kiện khó chịu vì bạn không thể thay đổi nó.

senses.definition: that you have used or relied on in the past successfully

examples.x: a tried and tested method for solving the problem

senses.definition_vi: mà bạn đã sử dụng hoặc dựa vào trong quá khứ một cách thành công.

senses.definition: to try as hard as you can (to do something)

examples.x: She tried her damnedest to get it done on time.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng hết sức (để làm điều gì đó).

senses.definition: to do something such as an activity or a sport for the first time
senses.definition_vi: làm một cái gì đó như một hoạt động hoặc một môn thể thao lần đầu tiên.

senses.definition: to behave badly towards somebody or try to get something from them, even though you know this will make them angry

examples.x: Children often try it on with new teachers.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử tệ với ai đó hoặc cố gắng lấy thứ gì đó từ họ, mặc dù bạn biết điều này sẽ khiến họ tức giận.

senses.definition: to try to start a sexual relationship with somebody
senses.definition_vi: cố gắng bắt đầu một mối quan hệ tình dục với ai đó.

senses.definition: to do something that involves risk or luck, hoping to succeed

examples.x: My grandparents emigrated to Canada to try their luck there.

senses.definition_vi: làm một điều gì đó có rủi ro hoặc may rủi, hy vọng thành công.

senses.definition: to make somebody feel impatient

examples.x: His stubbornness would try the patience of a saint.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy khó chịu.

senses.definition: an extremely large wave in the sea caused, for example, by an earthquake

examples.x: A tsunami early warning system was set up in Hawaii.
The tsunami caused immeasurable damage.

senses.definition_vi: một con sóng cực lớn trên biển, ví dụ do động đất gây ra.

senses.definition: a long, hollow pipe made of metal, plastic, rubber, etc., through which liquids or gases move from one place to another

examples.x: He had to be fed through a feeding tube for several months.
She poured the liquid down the tube.

senses.definition_vi: một ống rỗng dài bằng kim loại, nhựa, cao su, v.v., mà qua đó chất lỏng hoặc khí di chuyển từ nơi này sang nơi khác.

senses.definition: a hollow object in the shape of a pipe or tube

examples.x: the cardboard tube from the centre of a toilet roll
I put the poster back into its tube.

senses.definition_vi: một vật thể rỗng có hình dạng ống hoặc tuýp.

senses.definition: a long, narrow container made of soft metal or plastic, with a lid (= cover), used for holding thick liquids that can be forced out of it by pressing

examples.x: a tube of toothpaste
a tube of glue

senses.definition_vi: một vật chứa dài, hẹp bằng kim loại mềm hoặc nhựa, có nắp, dùng để đựng chất lỏng đặc có thể ép ra ngoài bằng cách bóp.

senses.definition: a can of beer

examples.x: a tube of lager

senses.definition_vi: một lon bia.

senses.definition: a part inside the body that is like a tube in shape and through which air, liquid, etc. passes

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ cẩn thận trước khi quyết định làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: not just once but twice

examples.x: There was enough of the drug in her stomach to kill her twice over.

senses.definition_vi: không chỉ một lần mà là hai lần

senses.definition: used to describe one of a pair of children who are twins

examples.x: a twin brother/sister
twin daughters/sons
twin boys/girls

senses.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả một trong cặp trẻ sinh đôi

senses.definition: used to describe two things that are used as a pair

examples.x: a ship with twin propellers

senses.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả hai thứ được sử dụng như một cặp

senses.definition: used to describe two things that are connected, or present or happening at the same time

examples.x: The prison service has the twin goals of punishment and rehabilitation.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả hai thứ được kết nối, hoặc có mặt hoặc xảy ra cùng lúc

senses.definition: one of two children born at the same time to the same mother

examples.x: She's expecting twins.
If you're carrying (= expecting) twins or triplets, that can put you at risk.
I'm 5 months pregnant with twins.

senses.definition_vi: một trong hai đứa trẻ sinh cùng lúc với cùng một người mẹ

senses.definition: one of two similar things that make a pair

examples.x: The plate was one of a pair but I broke its twin.

senses.definition_vi: một trong hai thứ tương tự tạo thành một cặp

senses.definition: the action of turning something with your hand, or of turning a part of your body

examples.x: She gave the lid another twist and it came off.
He gave a shy smile and a little twist of his head.
He finished him off with a quick twist of the knife.

senses.definition_vi: hành động xoay một thứ gì đó bằng tay của bạn, hoặc xoay một bộ phận cơ thể của bạn

senses.definition: an unexpected change or development in a story or situation

examples.x: the twists and turns of his political career
The story has taken another twist.
The disappearance of a vital witness added a new twist to the case.
By a curious twist of fate we met again only a week or so later.
a bizarre twist to the tale

senses.definition_vi: một sự thay đổi hoặc diễn biến bất ngờ trong một câu chuyện hoặc tình huống

senses.definition: a sharp bend in a road or river

examples.x: The car followed the twists and turns of the mountain road.
They approached a twist in the path.

senses.definition_vi: một khúc cua gấp trên đường hoặc sông

senses.definition: a thing that has been twisted into a particular shape

examples.x: mineral water with a twist of lemon

senses.definition_vi: một thứ đã được xoắn thành một hình dạng cụ thể

senses.definition: a fast dance that was popular in the 1960s, in which you twist from side to side
senses.definition_vi: một điệu nhảy nhanh phổ biến vào những năm 1960, trong đó bạn xoay người sang hai bên

senses.definition: to become angry, confused or upset
senses.definition_vi: trở nên tức giận, bối rối hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: crazy
senses.definition_vi: điên rồ

senses.definition: to bend or turn something into a particular shape

examples.x: Twist the wire to form a circle.
Her hair was twisted into a knot on top of her head.

senses.definition_vi: uốn cong hoặc xoay một thứ gì đó thành một hình dạng cụ thể

senses.definition: to bend or turn something into a shape or position that is not normal or natural; to be bent or turned in this way

examples.x: He grabbed me and twisted my arm behind my back.
Her face twisted in anger.

senses.definition_vi: uốn cong hoặc xoay một thứ gì đó thành một hình dạng hoặc vị trí không bình thường hoặc tự nhiên; bị uốn cong hoặc xoay theo cách này

senses.definition: to turn part of your body around while the rest stays still

examples.x: He twisted his head around to look at her.
She twisted in her chair when I called her name.

senses.definition_vi: xoay một bộ phận cơ thể của bạn trong khi phần còn lại vẫn giữ nguyên

senses.definition: to turn your body with quick, sharp movements and change direction often

examples.x: I twisted and turned to avoid being caught.
She tried unsuccessfully to twist free.
He managed to twist himself round in the restricted space.

senses.definition_vi: xoay người với những chuyển động nhanh, dứt khoát và thường xuyên thay đổi hướng

senses.definition: to turn something around in a circle with your hand

examples.x: Twist the knob to the left to open the door.
Nervously I twisted the ring on my finger.

senses.definition_vi: xoay một thứ gì đó tròn bằng tay của bạn

senses.definition: to bend and change direction often

examples.x: The road twists and turns along the coast.
narrow twisting streets
a twisting staircase

senses.definition_vi: uốn cong và thường xuyên thay đổi hướng

senses.definition: to injure part of your body, especially your ankle, wrist or knee, bending it in an uncomfortable way

examples.x: She fell and twisted her ankle.

senses.definition_vi: làm tổn thương một bộ phận cơ thể, đặc biệt là mắt cá chân, cổ tay hoặc đầu gối của bạn, bằng cách uốn cong nó một cách khó chịu

senses.definition: to wind something around or through an object

examples.x: She twisted a scarf around her head.
I twisted the bandage around his leg.
The telephone cable has got twisted (= wound around itself).

senses.definition_vi: quấn một thứ gì đó quanh hoặc xuyên qua một vật thể

senses.definition: to move or grow by winding around something

examples.x: A snake was twisting around his arm.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc phát triển bằng cách quấn quanh một thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to deliberately change the meaning of what somebody has said, or to present facts in a particular way, in order to benefit yourself or harm somebody else

examples.x: You always twist everything I say.
The newspaper was accused of twisting the facts.

senses.definition_vi: cố tình thay đổi ý nghĩa của những gì ai đó đã nói, hoặc trình bày sự thật theo một cách cụ thể, để mang lại lợi ích cho bản thân hoặc gây hại cho người khác

senses.definition: to turn or wind strings, etc. together to make something longer or thicker

examples.x: They had twisted the sheets into a rope and escaped by climbing down it.

senses.definition_vi: xoay hoặc quấn các sợi dây, v.v. lại với nhau để làm cho thứ gì đó dài hơn hoặc dày hơn

senses.definition: to say or do something unkind deliberately; to make somebody who is unhappy feel even more unhappy

examples.x: Marcia laughed as she twisted the knife still deeper.
Just to twist the knife, the filmmakers have provided a surprise ending.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm điều gì đó không hay một cách cố ý; làm cho người đang không vui cảm thấy còn tồi tệ hơn

senses.definition: to persuade or force somebody to do something
senses.definition_vi: thuyết phục hoặc buộc ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to persuade somebody to do anything that you want

examples.x: She has always been able to twist her parents around her little finger.

senses.definition_vi: thuyết phục ai đó làm bất cứ điều gì bạn muốn

examples.x: There are only two cookies left.
two of Sweden’s top financial experts
Ten people were invited but only two turned up.
Can you lend me two dollars?
a two-month contract
Look at page two.
Two and seven is nine.
Three twos are six.
I can't read your writing—is this meant to be a two?
The bulbs are planted in twos or threes (= groups of two or three).
We moved to America when I was two (= two years old).
Shall we meet at two (= at two o'clock), then?

senses.definition: to be unable to decide what you think about somebody/something, or whether to do something or not

examples.x: I was in two minds about the book (= I didn't know if I liked it or not).
She's in two minds about accepting his invitation.

senses.definition_vi: không thể quyết định bạn nghĩ gì về ai đó/điều gì đó, hoặc có nên làm điều gì đó hay không

senses.definition: one or a few days, moments, pounds, etc.

examples.x: May I borrow it for a day or two?

senses.definition_vi: một hoặc một vài ngày, khoảnh khắc, bảng Anh, v.v.

senses.definition: to fail to be or to get either of two choices, both of which would have been acceptable
senses.definition_vi: không đạt được hoặc không có được một trong hai lựa chọn, cả hai đều có thể chấp nhận được

senses.definition: in or into two pieces or halves

examples.x: He broke the bar of chocolate in two and gave me half.

senses.definition_vi: thành hai mảnh hoặc hai nửa

senses.definition: two or three at a time; in small numbers

examples.x: People arrived in twos and threes.

senses.definition_vi: từng hai hoặc ba cái một lúc; với số lượng nhỏ

senses.definition: very soon

examples.x: We’ll be there in a couple of shakes.

senses.definition_vi: rất sớm

senses.definition: one person cannot be completely responsible for something

examples.x: You can't put all the blame on him. It takes two to make a marriage.

senses.short_meaning_vi: không hoàn toàn chịu trách nhiệm
senses.definition_vi: một người không thể hoàn toàn chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that two people or groups, and not just one, are responsible for something that has happened (usually something bad)
senses.short_meaning_vi: cả hai cùng chịu trách nhiệm
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng hai người hoặc hai nhóm, chứ không chỉ một, chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó đã xảy ra (thường là điều xấu)

senses.definition: to be very poor, stupid, etc.
senses.definition_vi: rất nghèo, ngu ngốc, v.v.

senses.definition: to guess the truth from what you see, hear, etc.

examples.x: He's inclined to put two and two together and make five (= reaches the wrong conclusion from what he sees, hears, etc.).

senses.definition_vi: đoán đúng sự thật từ những gì bạn nhìn thấy, nghe thấy, v.v.

senses.definition: I am in the same position or I agree with you

examples.x: ‘I'm tired!’ ‘That makes two of us!’

senses.definition_vi: Tôi ở cùng vị trí hoặc tôi đồng ý với bạn

senses.definition: very common and therefore not valuable

examples.x: Teachers of history are ten a penny.

senses.definition_vi: rất phổ biến và do đó không có giá trị

senses.definition: used to talk about two ways of looking at the same situation
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói về hai cách nhìn nhận cùng một tình huống

senses.definition: a class or group of people or things that share particular qualities or features and are part of a larger group; a kind or sort

examples.x: a rare blood type
Bungalows are a type of house.
What type of car do you drive?
There are three main types of contract(s).
I think the same type of thing could happen here.
I am not the type of person who gives up easily.
He grew up listening to different types of music.
She mixes with all types of people.
She mixes with people of all types.
I love this type of book.
I love these types of books.
I love these type of books.
What do you charge for this type of work?
What do you charge for work of this type?
It is the first car of its type to have this design feature.

senses.definition_vi: một lớp hoặc nhóm người hoặc vật có chung những phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm cụ thể và là một phần của một nhóm lớn hơn; một loại hoặc hạng

senses.definition: a person of a particular character, with particular features, etc.

examples.x: She's the artistic type.
He's not the type to be unfaithful.
She's not my type (= not the kind of person I am usually attracted to).
The boss came back from holiday all relaxed and smiling, but now she's reverting to type (= returning to her usual behaviour).
True to type (= As he usually does), Adam turned up an hour late.

senses.definition_vi: một người có tính cách đặc biệt, với những đặc điểm đặc biệt, v.v.

senses.definition: having the qualities or features of the group, person or thing mentioned

examples.x: a police-type badge
a continental-type cafe

senses.definition_vi: có những phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm của nhóm, người hoặc vật được đề cập

senses.definition: letters that are printed or typed

examples.x: The type was too small for me to read.
The important words are in bold type.
Key paragraphs of the report are set in italic type.

senses.definition_vi: các chữ cái được in hoặc đánh máy

senses.definition: to write something using a computer keyboard or typewriter

examples.x: How fast can you type?
typing errors
I typed my name and password.
Type (in) the filename, then press ‘Return’.
This letter will need to be typed (out) again.
Have you typed up that report yet?

senses.definition_vi: viết một cái gì đó bằng cách sử dụng bàn phím máy tính hoặc máy đánh chữ

senses.definition: to find out the group or class that a person or thing belongs to

examples.x: Blood samples were taken from patients for typing.

senses.definition_vi: tìm ra nhóm hoặc lớp mà một người hoặc vật thuộc về

senses.definition: having the usual qualities or features of a particular type of person, thing or group

examples.x: a typical Italian cafe
This is a typical example of Roman pottery.
Judy is a typical American teenager.
This meal is typical of local cookery.
The weather at the moment is not typical for July.

senses.definition_vi: có những phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm thông thường của một loại người, vật hoặc nhóm cụ thể

senses.definition: happening in the usual way; showing what something is usually like

examples.x: A typical working day for me begins at 7.30.
On a typical day, we receive about 50 letters.
Draw up your own budget for a typical week.
Typical interview questions are ‘Why do you want to study law?’ or ‘Why did you choose this college?’

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra theo cách thông thường; cho thấy điều gì đó thường như thế nào

senses.definition: behaving in the way that you expect

examples.x: He spoke with typical enthusiasm.
The characters don't react to their situation in typical horror movie fashion.
It was typical of her to forget.
She's late again—typical!

senses.definition_vi: hành xử theo cách bạn mong đợi

senses.definition: used to say that something usually happens in the way that you are stating

examples.x: The standard chips are typically used for databases and other business software.
Generating solar power has typically involved higher capital costs.
The Bengal tiger is typically found in the forests of Central and Southern India.
The factory typically produces 500 chairs a week.
A typically priced meal will be around $10.
Typically, the contracts were for five years.
Pears are available year-round, but they are typically associated with autumn.
It typically takes several years of losses before you see any profits.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó thường xảy ra theo cách bạn đang nêu

senses.definition: in a way that shows the usual qualities or features of a particular type of person, thing or group

examples.x: typically American hospitality
Mothers typically worry about their children.
typically male behaviour

senses.definition_vi: theo cách thể hiện những phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm thông thường của một loại người, vật hoặc nhóm cụ thể

senses.definition: in the way that you expect somebody/something to behave

examples.x: Typically, she couldn't find her keys.
He was typically modest about his achievements.
He mounted a typically robust defence of his own role in the matter.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách bạn mong đợi ai đó/điều gì đó cư xử

senses.definition: a thick rubber ring that fits around the edge of a wheel of a car, bicycle, etc.

examples.x: a front/rear tyre
to pump up a tyre
a flat tyre
Someone had slashed the tyres on her car.
Remember to check your tyre pressure regularly.
a burst/punctured tyre
bald/worn tyres
car/bicycle tyres
He drove off with a screech of tyres.
I need him to show me how to change a tyre.
Keeping your tyres inflated to the proper pressure can improve mileage.

senses.definition_vi: một vòng cao su dày vừa với mép bánh xe ô tô, xe đạp, v.v.

senses.definition: to test the quality of something to see whether it is suitable for you before you buy it
senses.definition_vi: kiểm tra chất lượng của một cái gì đó để xem liệu nó có phù hợp với bạn trước khi bạn mua nó không

senses.definition: used to say that something happened continuously or frequently during a period in the past

examples.x: I used to live in London.
That's what my father always used to say.
I didn't use to like him much when we were at school.
Didn't you use to have long hair?
I used to think that it would be a great idea to live there.
We used to go sailing on the lake in summer.
She used to work for a large insurance company.
I used to play a lot of football.
You used to see a lot of her, didn't you?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó đã xảy ra liên tục hoặc thường xuyên trong một khoảng thời gian trong quá khứ
